task: binary classification: synthesis feasible (label=1) vs not (label=0)
esm_pooling: mean-pooled last_hidden_state, CLS/EOS special tokens masked out before pooling, no L2 normalization
ensemble_method: unweighted mean of predict_proba positive-class probability across the 3 models (soft voting); notebook itself does not define a cross-model ensembling scheme, this is a downstream choice
data_variant: base (pipeline.ipynb, PepSySco.csv, 1771 peptides after de-duplication) — not the combined/3560-peptide variant

svm.probability_calibration_check: confirmed probability=True at load time; predict_proba is valid (uses Platt scaling internally)

train_val_split: 5-fold StratifiedKFold, shuffle=True, random_state=42, refit on full dataset for the cached artifacts

independent_validation_roc_auc.validation_set_source: MS2-PSM-derived peptide-synthesis-error dataset (SPL*_DB_search files), labeled by spectral-count success ratio R_p > 0.5

generalization_warning: independent-validation ROC-AUC dropped roughly to chance level relative to CV; treat this ensemble's real-world discrimination as weak and unverified beyond this one out-of-distribution check
